title: Which of these five shapes can be folded to match?
description: An arrowhead shape, a kite, a slanted four-sided shape, a bent shape like a letter L and a triangle with unequal sides are folded one by one. The fold lines that make the halves match are found.
teaching_notes: One idea: look for a fold line that makes the halves cover each other exactly, and say clearly when no such line exists. Watch for students who draw a line only because the shape looks neat.

source: For each of the following figures, identify the line(s) of symmetry if it exists.
video_script.why: The child hunts for a matching fold in each of five shapes and learns that some shapes have no such line.
video_script.substitution: Fold each shape in the mind and look for a line that makes both halves match.
video_script.anchor: Five shapes: an arrowhead, a kite, a slanted four-sided shape, a bent shape like a letter L and a triangle with unequal sides
video_script.payoff_line: Only a fold that matches exactly is a line of symmetry.

final_answer.value: arrowhead: 1 line, slanted through its tip; kite: 1 line, vertical; slanted four-sided shape: none; bent shape: 1 line, diagonal through its corner; triangle with unequal sides: none
final_answer.spoken: the arrowhead has one slanted line, the kite has one vertical line, the slanted four-sided shape has none, the bent shape has one diagonal line, and the triangle with unequal sides has none

never_show: the counts before the folds are made
a line drawn on the slanted four-sided shape
maths_rules: A line of symmetry is a fold line along which one half covers the other exactly.
The arrowhead has one line of symmetry, a slanted line through its tip.
The kite has one line, the vertical one.
The slanted four-sided shape has none.
The bent shape like a letter L has one line, the diagonal through its corner.
The triangle with unequal sides has none.
Check: fold along each found line and see the halves cover each other.
video_script.design: One idea: look for a matching fold in each shape. Assumes the child has seen the fold test for mirror halves. The five shapes stay on the board from the hook to the end.
open_questions: The answer relies on the shapes as described in the worklist: the arrowhead with a notch, the kite, the slanted four-sided shape with two right angles, the bent shape like a letter L, and the triangle with unequal sides.
